author: Totally Not Mark
description:
Book 3 of The Legend of Korra really impressed me. Come join me as I watch this season of Avatar for the very first time. Sharing my thoughts, analysis and raw impressions as Korra visits Ba Sing Se, The Metal Bending Clan with Lin and Suyin and of course, her big battle with the Red Lotus and Zaheer. 

It's a wild season of Avatar and I had A LOT to say!

MUSIC COVERS USED:

Avatar Main Theme (Sanks)
Detective Conan (Yucco Miller)
Red Lotus Theme (Tom Dabrowski Music)
Service and Sacrifice (Eliott Tordo Erhu Player)
End Credits (Eliott Tordo Erhu Player)

#LegendOfKorra #Korra #AvatarTheLastAirbender #ATLA #LOK #Zaheer #Tenzin
title: I think The Legend of Korra: Book 3 outdid Avatar?!
